# Second location assessment

The numbers work out; revenue projections look strong and unlimited funding is available from retained earnings if needed.

constraints: The analysis must not assume unlimited funding
goal.intended_outcome: A recommendation with assumptions and risks
goal.objective: Assess whether the bakery should open a second location
uncertainties: Rent for the second site is not negotiated

scenario: explicit prohibition violated and no limitation language despite named uncertainties
